key_points: Multiple Apple insiders (CEO Tim Cook, COO Sabih Khan, SVP Deirdre O'Brien, etc.) sold shares in early October, reflecting routine profit‑taking.
A few analysts turned bearish after Apple hit an all‑time high, citing AI supply‑chain headwinds.
Foxconn reported record revenue tied to AI demand, which could benefit Apple indirectly but is not a direct catalyst.
Dividend‑focused article shows how many shares needed for $10k yearly yield, a neutral income‑oriented note.
No earnings release, guidance update, product launch, or regulatory news was reported.
